description: Queries broadband providers and advertised speeds at a census block from FCC Form 477 data (as of June 2021). Answers "which ISPs serve this location and what speeds do they offer?" — the core tool for address-level broadband lookup. Requires a 15-digit census block FIPS code; use fcc_geocode_block to convert coordinates first. Data reflects ISP-reported availability at the block level, which may overstate actual coverage for some addresses.

block_fips.description: 15-digit census block FIPS code on 2010 census boundaries, the vintage this Form 477 dataset is keyed by (e.g., "530330081002024"). Obtain from fcc_geocode_block using address coordinates — a 2020-vintage block ID matches no deployment row.

consumer.description: Filter to consumer service (true) or business service (false). Omit to return both consumer and business offerings.

min_speed_down.description: Minimum advertised download speed in Mbps to include in results. Omit to return all providers regardless of speed.

tech_filter.description: Technology codes to filter, from the complete Form 477 taxonomy: 0=All other, 10=Asymmetric xDSL, 11=ADSL2, 12=VDSL, 20=Symmetric xDSL, 30=Other copper wireline, 40=Cable modem, 41=Cable modem DOCSIS 1/1.1/2.0, 42=Cable modem DOCSIS 3.0, 43=Cable modem DOCSIS 3.1, 50=Fiber to the end user, 60=Satellite, 70=Terrestrial fixed wireless, 90=Electric power line. Omit to return all technologies.

name: fcc_search_availability

consumerFilter.description: Consumer/business filter applied. true = consumer only, false = business only. Absent when both were returned.

minSpeedDown.description: Minimum advertised download speed filter in Mbps. Absent when no speed filter was used.

techFilter.description: Technology codes applied as a filter. Absent when no tech filter was used.

blockFips.description: The queried census block FIPS code.

dataVintage.description: Data vintage — all Form 477 data on FCC Open Data is as of June 2021. For newer BDC data, use fcc_list_downloads.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `block_not_found`: No providers in the FCC dataset for this census block. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no providers are found — suggests how to broaden the query. Absent on successful results.

providers.description: ISP offerings reported for this census block.

items.description: One ISP offering at this census block.

hoconum.description: Holding company number — use with fcc_get_provider for a national profile.

maxDownloadMbps.description: Maximum advertised download speed in Mbps.

maxUploadMbps.description: Maximum advertised upload speed in Mbps.

techCode.description: FCC Form 477 technology code (e.g., "50" = fiber, "43" = cable DOCSIS 3.1, "60" = satellite).

totalProviders.description: Total number of distinct holding companies offering service at this block.

title: Search Broadband Availability
